## Key Projects
- **Prahari-Link (प्रहरी-Link)**: Emergency offline disaster communication bridge connecting remote Himalayan communities via LoRa/ESP-NOW and BLE. (Nepal Police Hackathon 2nd Place).
- **AI Trial Nepal (aitrialnp.com)**: Virtual try-on software suite with Cloudflare Workers, PostgreSQL, and high-fidelity clothing draping.
- **VastuVision AI (vastuvision-beta.vercel.app)**: Hybrid web and native Android camera application analyzing architectural floorplans with computer vision and Groq AI.
- **MR Tour Service (manoranjan.com.np)**: Commercial tour operator booking and operations system.
- **Ar. Anushka Khatri Portfolio (anushkakhatri.com.np)**: Interactive architectural portfolio with dynamic CAD slider and material flat-lays.
- **Lazzybiointel-v6.2-PRO**: Forensic-grade biometric facial recognition system built with Python, InsightFace, and MediaPipe.
- **Deepfake-Analyzer**: Privacy-first offline deepfake detection workbench using Rust and PyTorch.
